text:
### Cancellation Confirmation  
**Customer Receives:**
- Email confirmation of cancellation
- Standing order ID that was canceled
- Date of cancellation
- Confirmation that no further payments will be made

raw_entities.description: The end-to-end procedure for canceling an active standing order on a customer account. The process culminates in a cancellation confirmation sent to the customer via email, documenting the standing order ID, cancellation date, and confirmation that no further payments will be processed.
